_comment: Hermes Agent MCP server configuration for mcp-agent-factory gateway (INT-01).

_versions_tested.component_a_validated: tools/list returns 6 tools; hermes mcp test passes (5254ms)

mcp-agent-factory-dev._comment_auth: Mode 1 — dev mode (MCP_DEV_MODE=1 on the gateway). No auth. Local experiments only.

_how_to_obtain: Save the returned client_id and client_secret.
3. Paste the access_token value below (replace PASTE_TOKEN_HERE).
4. Token lifetime is set by the auth server (default 3600 s). Rotate before expiry.
Automation: re-run step 2 and update the config — there is no silent renewal for static tokens.

mcp-agent-factory-pkce._comment_auth: Mode 3 — OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Hermes must support RFC 8414 discovery.
mcp-agent-factory-pkce._known_limitation: Verify whether Hermes' OAuth client matches the gateway's RFC 8414 discovery and RFC 7591 dynamic registration. Record the outcome in docs/integrations/hermes-herdr.md.

_tool_scopes._note: The gateway enforces these scopes server-side. Hermes-side filtering is defense-in-depth only.

_destructive_tools._note: orchestrate is blocked from direct tools/call outside DEV_MODE. It requires the graph execution path (agents/analyze or POST /mcp/jobs). Follow-up issue to route it through human-in-the-loop approval.

_security_reminders: Never commit a file with a real token or client_secret — use placeholders only.
MCP_DEV_MODE=1 bypasses all auth; never use it outside local experiments.
The auth server (:8001) must not be reachable from the public internet.
Hermes keeps persistent memory and creates skills from experience. Use a test tenant during validation.
Tool results returned to Hermes reach Hermes' own model provider — the gateway's PII scrubbing covers only its own LLM calls.
